game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: GhostofSparta75
quote: Lacks key/core GTA components. The story and the game in general seems as though Rockstar tried to improve GTA by going a different route, but it takes away what makes GTA a GTA game. That's not including the pay walls they have in place now and in the near future. Rockstar definitely fumbled the ball with this one. Good game, but not a good GTA game. Definitely has room for improvement, and if there is ever a GTA 7, Rockstar needs to do better.
